name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
description: Income support of Rs. 6,000 per year in three equal installments directly transferred into bank accounts of all landholding farmer families across India.
description_hi: सभी पात्र भूमिधारक किसान परिवारों को ₹6,000 प्रति वर्ष की वित्तीय सहायता, तीन समान किस्तों में सीधे बैंक खाते में प्रदान की जाती है।
benefits: Direct financial assistance of ₹6,000 per financial year.
Paid in three 4-monthly installments of ₹2,000 each via DBT.
Direct Aadhaar-linked payment into bank accounts without middlemen.
application_steps: Visit the official PM-KISAN portal (pmkisan.gov.in).
Click on 'New Farmer Registration' under Farmers Corner.
Enter Aadhaar number and select Rural or Urban Farmer Registration.
Fill landholding survey number, bank details, and submit.
Complete eKYC via OTP or biometric CSC centre.

name: Ayushman Bharat PM Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)
name_hi: आयुष्मान भारत प्रधानमंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना (पीएम-जय)
description: World's largest government-funded health protection scheme providing health coverage of up to Rs. 5 Lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary healthcare hospitalization.
description_hi: प्रति परिवार प्रति वर्ष ₹5 लाख तक का कैशलेस स्वास्थ्य बीमा माध्यमिक और तृतीयक अस्पताल में भर्ती के लिए प्रदान किया जाता है।
benefits: Cashless hospitalization coverage up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year.
Covers pre-existing diseases from Day 1.
Cashless treatment across thousands of empaneled public and private hospitals across India.
documents: Ration Card or proof of family identity
application_steps: Check eligibility on the NHA portal (beneficiary.nha.gov.in).
Login with mobile number and Aadhaar OTP.
Search family members via Ration Card or Aadhaar.
Complete e-KYC online or visit nearest CSC/empaneled hospital.
Download Ayushman Card (Golden Card) instantly upon approval.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
description: Financial assistance to houseless households and those living in kutcha and dilapidated houses in rural areas for the construction of pucca houses with basic amenities.
description_hi: ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों में बेघर और कच्चे/जीर्ण-शीर्ण घरों में रहने वाले परिवारों को पक्का मकान निर्माण हेतु वित्तीय सहायता।
benefits: Unit grant assistance of ₹1,20,000 in plain areas and ₹1,30,000 in hilly/difficult areas.
Additional 90/95 person-days of unskilled labor support under MGNREGS.
₹12,000 assistance for toilet construction via Swachh Bharat Mission (SBM).
application_steps: Beneficiary selection is based on SECC 2011 and Awaas+ list verified by Gram Sabha.
Contact local Gram Panchayat or Block Development Officer (BDO).
Geo-tagging of current house and proposed house location.
Installment release directly to Aadhaar-linked bank account upon stage inspection.

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)
description: Collateral-free micro loans up to Rs. 20 Lakh to non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises and self-employed entrepreneurs.
description_hi: गैर-कॉर्पोरेट, गैर-कृषि लघु/सूक्ष्म उद्यमों और स्वरोजगार हेतु ₹20 लाख तक का संपार्श्विक-मुक्त (बिना गारंटी) ऋण।
benefits: Shishu: Loans up to ₹50,000 for starting new business.
Kishore: Loans above ₹50,000 and up to ₹5,00,000.
Tarun: Loans above ₹5,00,000 and up to ₹10,00,000 (expanded to ₹20 Lakh).
No collateral or security required.
documents: Proof of Identity (Aadhaar, Voter ID, PAN)
Business registration / proof of business address
application_steps: Formulate business proposal and loan requirement.
Visit any commercial bank, RRB, Small Finance Bank, or MFI.
Alternatively, apply online through Udyamimitra portal (udyamimitra.in).
Submit application form along with business plan and KYC documents.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
description: High-interest, tax-free small savings scheme for girl children to secure their higher education and marriage expenses, opened by parents/guardians before the girl turns 10.
description_hi: बालिकाओं के उज्ज्वल भविष्य, उच्च शिक्षा और विवाह के लिए उच्च ब्याज दर वाली कर-मुक्त बचत योजना।
benefits: Attractive government-guaranteed interest rate (currently 8.2% p.a.).
Triple tax exemption (EEE) under Section 80C of Income Tax Act.
Minimum annual deposit of ₹250, maximum ₹1,50,000 per financial year.
documents: Birth Certificate of the girl child
Identity proof of parent / guardian (Aadhaar, PAN)
application_steps: Visit any Post Office or authorized public/private commercial bank branch.
Obtain and fill the SSY Account Opening Form.
Attach birth certificate and guardian KYC documents.
Deposit initial opening amount (minimum ₹250) and collect passbook.

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
description: Government-backed guaranteed monthly pension scheme for citizens working in the unorganized sector, providing monthly pension of Rs. 1,000 to Rs. 5,000 after age 60.
description_hi: असंगठित क्षेत्र के कामगारों के लिए 60 वर्ष की आयु के बाद ₹1,000 से ₹5,000 तक की निश्चित मासिक पेंशन योजना।
benefits: Guaranteed minimum monthly pension of ₹1,000, ₹2,000, ₹3,000, ₹4,000, or ₹5,000 upon reaching 60 years.
Same pension amount continues to spouse upon subscriber death.
Return of full accumulated pension corpus to the designated nominee upon demise of both spouse and subscriber.
documents: Savings Bank account with auto-debit facility
application_steps: Approach your bank branch or access net banking/mobile banking.
Fill APY subscriber registration form.
Select desired monthly pension tier (₹1,000 - ₹5,000).
Set auto-debit for monthly/quarterly contribution.

name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
name_hi: पीएम स्ट्रीट वेंडर्स आत्मनिर्भर निधि (पीएम स्वनिधि)
description: Micro-credit facility offering working capital collateral-free loans to urban and peri-urban street vendors with interest subsidy of 7% for timely repayment and digital transaction incentives.
description_hi: शहरी वेंडरों और रेहड़ी-पटरी वालों को ₹50,000 तक का सस्ता कार्यशील पूंजी ऋण, 7% ब्याज सब्सिडी के साथ।
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
benefits: First tranche working capital loan of up to ₹10,00, second up to ₹20,000, and third up to ₹50,000.
Interest subsidy at 7% per annum credited to bank account quarterly.
Cashback incentives up to ₹1,200/year on digital transactions.
documents: Vending Certificate / Identity Card issued by Urban Local Body (ULB) or Letter of Recommendation (LoR)
application_steps: Visit PM SVANidhi portal (pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in) or mobile app.
Login with mobile number linked to Aadhaar.
Verify Certificate of Vending or request LoR from Municipal Corporation.
Select preferred Lending Institution and submit application.
source_name: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
name_hi: इंदिरा गांधी राष्ट्रीय वृद्धावस्था पेंशन योजना
description: Non-contributory monthly pension scheme for senior citizens aged 60 and above belonging to below poverty line (BPL) or low-income households.
description_hi: 60 वर्ष और उससे अधिक आयु के बीपीएल और निम्न आय वर्ग के वरिष्ठ नागरिकों के लिए मासिक वित्तीय पेंशन सहायता।
benefits: Monthly financial pension directly transferred via DBT.
Central component supplemented by state government contributions.
Increased rate for super-senior citizens aged 80 and above.
documents: Age proof certificate / School leaving certificate / Voter ID
BPL Ration Card or Income Certificate
application_steps: Apply through the State Social Welfare portal or NSAP online portal (nsap.nic.in).
Alternatively, submit physical application to Block Development Office (BDO) or Tehsildar.
Verification by Gram Panchayat Secretary or Municipal Inspector.
Monthly pension disbursal starts into beneficiary's bank/post office account.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC/ST/OBC Students
name_hi: अनुसूचित जाति/जनजाति/अन्य पिछड़ा वर्ग हेतु पोस्ट-मैट्रिक छात्रवृत्ति
description: Financial assistance to students from marginalized communities studying at post-matriculation or post-secondary stage to enable them to complete higher education.
description_hi: हाशिए के समुदायों (SC/ST/OBC) के छात्रों को 10वीं के बाद उच्च शिक्षा पूरी करने के लिए संपूर्ण शिक्षण शुल्क और निर्वाह भत्ता सहायता।
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
benefits: Full non-refundable compulsory course fee reimbursement paid to the institution.
Monthly maintenance allowance for hostellers and day scholars.
Additional allowances for study tours, book grants, and dissertation preparation.
documents: Caste / Community Certificate issued by competent authority
Admission fee receipt and College ID
application_steps: Register on the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in).
Complete Aadhaar Face Authentication / OTR (One Time Registration).
Select Post-Matric Scheme matching category and state.
Upload verified documents and submit for Institute verification.
Direct disbursement through Aadhaar Payment Bridge (APB).

name: Divyangjan Swavalamban Scheme (NHFDC)
description: Concessional credit scheme for persons with disabilities (PwD) to promote entrepreneurship, vocational education, and purchase of assistive technologies.
description_hi: दिव्यांग व्यक्तियों के आर्थिक सशक्तिकरण और स्वरोजगार हेतु अत्यधिक रियायती ब्याज दरों पर ऋण और सहायता।
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
benefits: Concessional interest rate loan (4% - 8% p.a.) up to ₹50 Lakh for self-employment enterprises.
Rebate on prompt repayment.
Financial assistance for assistive devices and professional skill development.
documents: UDID Card (Unique Disability ID) or Disability Certificate (40% or more)
application_steps: Apply through State Channelising Agencies (SCAs) or designated partner banks.
Submit application on the official NHFDC portal (nhfdc.org).
Interview and project evaluation by District Level Committee.
Loan sanction and fund transfer directly to account.
source_name: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities

name: Prime Minister's Internship Scheme (PMIS)
description: Government-backed 12-month internship program in India's top 500 companies offering youth real-world business experience and monthly financial stipends.
description_hi: भारत की शीर्ष 500 कंपनियों में 12 महीने की व्यावहारिक इंटर्नशिप, मासिक ₹5,000 वजीफे और एकमुश्त ₹6,000 सहायता के साथ।
benefits: Monthly financial stipend of ₹5,000 (₹4,500 by Government + ₹500 by Partner Company).
One-time incidentals grant of ₹6,000 upon joining the internship.
Insurance coverage under PM Jeevan Jyoti Bima and PM Suraksha Bima.
documents: Educational qualification certificate (High School, Diploma, Degree)
application_steps: Register on the official PM Internship Portal (pminternship.mca.gov.in).
Complete eKYC verification and candidate profile creation.
Browse available internship roles across top partner companies.
Select up to 5 preferred opportunities and submit.

name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY 4.0)
description: Flagship skill certification scheme of the Ministry of Skill Development & Entrepreneurship to enable Indian youth to take up industry-relevant skill training.
description_hi: भारतीय युवाओं को नि:शुल्क उद्योग-प्रासंगिक कौशल प्रशिक्षण, राष्ट्रीय प्रमाणन और मौद्रिक पुरस्कार प्रदान करने की प्रमुख योजना।
ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
target_beneficiaries: Unemployed youth seeking marketable vocational skills
benefits: 100% free technical and industry-aligned skill certification.
Government-issued National Skills Qualifications Framework (NSQF) certificate.
Post-training placement assistance and apprenticeship linkage.
application_steps: Visit the Skill India Digital Hub portal (skillindiadigital.gov.in).
Search for nearby PMKVY affiliated training centers.
Enroll in the desired skill course or job role.
Complete assessment and receive NSDC recognized certification.
